default_when_silent.quote: You should only use generative AI if your School has explicitly allowed it for a specific module or assessment.

decided_by.quote: You should only use generative AI if your School has explicitly allowed it for a specific module or assessment.
If you are unsure what is allowed, check with your module convenor.
If the use of generative AI is allowed for a particular module or assessment, this will be stated clearly in your assessment guidance.
Your assessment guidance will contain one of the following statements:

duty.quote: If your module or tutor has given you explicit permission to use AI, you should include an acknowledgement in your work.

contents.quote: I acknowledge the use of [1. insert AI system(s) and link] on [date] to [2.specific use of generative artificial intelligence].
I acknowledge the use of [1. insert AI system(s) and link] on [date] to [2.specific use of generative artificial intelligence].
The output from these prompts was used to [4. explain use].
The prompts used include [3. list of prompts].

location.quote: If your module or tutor has given you explicit permission to use AI, you should include an acknowledgement in your work.

records.quote: If AI use is permitted, you must keep a record of the prompts you used, the outputs generated, and how those outputs informed your work.

referencing.quote: You should follow the guidance provided by your module and the referencing style used in your subject when acknowledging or citing AI use.

consequence.quote: Using AI in an assessment where it is not permitted, or submitting AI-generated work without the required acknowledgement, is academic misconduct under the University’s policy on the misuse of digital technologies.
